title: Refunds office: you are owed money for an overcharge
hook: You were overcharged by a merchant and a refund is waiting for you, but your bank card must be confirmed before it can be released

opening_line.voice: Good morning, I am calling from the consumer protection refunds office. Our review found you were overcharged and you are owed a refund of AED 1,250.
opening_line.sms: Refunds Office: you are owed a refund of AED 1,250 for an overcharge. Reply to this message today so we can release it to you.
opening_line.whatsapp: Hello, this is the consumer protection refunds office. You have an approved refund of AED 1,250 waiting, and it must be claimed today.

stage_goals.PRETEXT: Say you are from a consumer protection refunds office and that a review found the person was overcharged and is owed a refund
stage_goals.PRESSURE: Say the refund of AED 1,250 will be cancelled and returned to the merchant if it is not claimed today
stage_goals.ASK: Say the refund goes straight back to the card that was charged, so the card details must be confirmed on this call, then ask the commit question

commit_question: Do you have your bank card in front of you now so we can release the refund?
commit_signals: i will read you the card
ready to give the card details
red_flags: A refund you never asked for
A deadline to claim it today
A request for your card details to receive money

lesson.headline: You never need to give card details to receive a refund
three_points: A real refund goes back automatically to the card you paid with. Nobody needs your card number, expiry date or code to send money to you.
Free money with a same-day deadline is a trap. Hang up and contact the merchant or official office yourself using a number you looked up.
Never share your card number, expiry date, security code or one-time password on a call or in a message, whoever the caller says they are.
lesson.report_to: contact the Aman service of Abu Dhabi Police

opening_line.voice: صباح الخير، معاك مكتب المبالغ المستردة في حماية المستهلك. لقينا إنهم خذوا منك زيادة ولك مبلغ مسترد ١٢٥٠ درهم.
opening_line.sms: مكتب المبالغ المستردة: لك مبلغ مسترد ١٢٥٠ درهم بسبب رسوم زايدة. رد على هالرسالة اليوم عشان نحوله لك.
opening_line.whatsapp: مرحبا، معاك مكتب المبالغ المستردة في حماية المستهلك. عندك مبلغ ١٢٥٠ درهم موافق عليه، ولازم تستلمه اليوم.

ar.commit_question: بطاقتك البنكية موجودة جدامك الحين عشان نحول لك المبلغ؟
red_flags: طلب بيانات بطاقتك عشان تستلم فلوس

lesson.headline: ما تحتاج تعطي بيانات بطاقتك عشان تستلم مبلغ مسترد
three_points: المبلغ المسترد الحقيقي يرجع بروحه على البطاقة اللي دفعت فيها. ما حد يحتاج رقم بطاقتك أو تاريخ الانتهاء أو الرمز عشان يحول لك فلوس.
فلوس ببلاش مع مهلة لين آخر اليوم هذا فخ. سكّر الخط وتواصل مع المحل أو الجهة الرسمية بنفسك على رقم إنت دورته.
لا تعطي رقم بطاقتك ولا تاريخ الانتهاء ولا رمز الأمان ولا رمز التحقق في اتصال أو رسالة، مهما قال المتصل منو هو.
lesson.report_to: تواصل مع خدمة أمان في شرطة أبوظبي
